source_acquisition.explanation: 11 of 12 predeclared historical source files were acquired; NOAA station 46042 year 2024 returned HTTP 404. The failure receipt and successful downloads were preserved. No alternate year was substituted after outcomes were inspected.
source_acquisition.authentication: public source files; no user API key required

corrections_to_earlier_claims.current_claim_decision: Earlier geothermal percentages and zero-selected-loss language are exploratory historical outputs, not reliable evidence of deployable superiority or fail-safe performance.
additional_code_review_findings: Earlier next-stage validation selection did not purge all target timestamps crossing the evaluation boundary
Earlier whole-block drift feedback became visible in code before every horizon-delayed outcome from that block had matured
corrections_to_earlier_claims.comparison_caveat: This round changes preprocessing, origin sampling, window selection and evaluation splits together. The change in scores must not be attributed quantitatively to one bug alone.

forge1683_reanalysis.target: raw uncorrected SEP FLOW TOTAL in gpm
forge1683_reanalysis.interpretation: The conservative gate used persistence throughout evaluation. That avoids using this losing smoother but is not an improvement over persistence and does not demonstrate intelligent optimization.

separate_year_wave_screen.target: WVHT squared multiplied by APD, units m^2 s; wave activity proxy, not generated electricity or calibrated wave power

other_near_misses.decision: HOLD: predeclared 5 percent effect threshold not met

claim_boundary: Standard moving averages are baselines, not evidence of proprietary LumenCore novelty. Data from a different historical year are not third-party validation. No equipment control, operational safety limits, production deployment, measured electricity gains, bankability conclusion, or revenue claim was produced.
next_research_priority: Compare a clearly specified LumenCore-specific method against both persistence and this stronger rolling baseline on another predeclared untouched period, with timestamps and label availability locked before scoring.
